sources.snippet: 3. Datasets The growing need for high-level understanding and interaction in 3D environments — such as in robotics and embodied AI — has first stimulated the construction of 3D SQA datasets. Datasets are fundamental to model development and evaluation in 3D SQA. Existing datasets vary widely in scene representation, scale, and query complexity.
